items.headline: $PAPER: Papertrade Hit by Oracle-Manipulation Allegation
items.summary: A wallet allegedly booked $1.73M in realized gains on PaperDash while $PAPER's loss-funded house pool shows $3.14M. Unpaid winnings queue if cash runs short.

items.headline: $FIL Vesting Ends: Annual Supply Unlocks to Drop 76%
items.summary: Filecoin's six-year vesting is nearly over, cutting annualized $FIL additions from ~89M to ~21M. A major supply-overhang lift for the storage token.

items.headline: Tokenized Apple, Nvidia & Tesla Stocks Launch on $SOL
items.summary: Securitize brings share-backed Apple, Nvidia and Tesla tokens to Solana for eligible US and EU investors via its broker-dealer platform. Big RWA win for $SOL.

items.headline: $CC: Canton Tops All Chains With $60M in 30-Day Fees
items.summary: Canton Network generated $60.2M in 30-day fees, far outpacing Tron and Ethereum per DefiLlama. Institutional RWA flows keep driving $CC usage.

items.headline: $ETH L2 Base Ships Cobalt With Conditional Transactions
items.summary: Base's third upgrade of 2026 adds dormant conditional transactions, a seize function and B20 token standard changes on the leading $ETH Layer 2.
